verdict.rationale: Groq documents an OpenAI-compatible API: an agent can target it with standard OpenAI client libraries by changing only the api_key and base_url to https://api.groq.com/openai/v1. Its chat completions, streaming, and tool calling follow the familiar shape. Groq itself calls the API only "mostly compatible" with OpenAI's client libraries, an acknowledged caveat that falls short of seamless provider-agnostic switching. missing for 10: documentation of which OpenAI chat-completions parameters or behaviors are unsupported or differ, and independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent switching providers mid-workflow without code changes.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent switch to or away from this provider mid-workflow because it speaks the standard chat-completions API without provider-specific code changes

citations.quote: To start using Groq with OpenAI's client libraries, pass your Groq API key to the api_key parameter and change the base_url to https://api.groq.com/openai/v1
We designed Groq API to be mostly compatible with OpenAI's client libraries, making it easy to configure your existing applications to run on Groq
